question.text: Identify the wrong statements in the following:

options.text: Chlorofluorocarbons are responsible for ozone layer depletion
Greenhouse effect is responsible for global warming
Ozone layer does not permit infrared radiation from the sun to reach the earth
Acid rains is mostly because of oxides of nitrogen and sulphur

solution.text: Ozone layer does not allow ultraviolet radiation from sun to reach earth.
